text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, Mayano Top 
Gun devoted herself to various training 
exercises just to earn praise from her 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Boasting that she had grown strong enough, 
she took a bold stance, declaring she 
would deliver a race even more thrilling 
than Narita Brian's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And to prove it, she decided to challenge 
the race on the Triple Crown path that 
Narita Brian had walked—the Kikuka Sho.
